نمج (form I)
# نَمُجُّ (namujju) /na.mud͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of مَجَّ (majja)
# نُمَجُّ (numajju) /nu.mad͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of مَجَّ (majja)
# نَمُجَّ (namujja) /na.mud͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of مَجَّ (majja)
# نُمَجَّ (numajja) /nu.mad͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past passive
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
